title: Why the Lexus LFA Is Worth More Now Than New
description:
In two thousand ten, the Lexus LFA launched with a price of three hundred seventy-five thousand dollars, and sales were slow. In April twenty twenty-four, one sold for eight hundred ninety thousand dollars. More than double. And a special version has sold for one point six million. This is why the Lexus LFA is worth more now than when it was new, and what the sources say about it. Here is the twist. Not one of the sales we are about to show you is a guarantee. They are single auctions. Some cars did not sell at all. And there is one thing about the LFA's value that has nothing to do with the car's performance. We will show you the numbers, the reasons the sources give, and the limits of what anyone can know.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
